change: Add Lower Animation Ticks to CheatBreaker Settings > FPS Boost.

setting.name: Lower Animation Ticks
setting.meaning: Texture animation updates per second within the existing 20 Hz game tick loop. 20 preserves vanilla speed, 10 is half speed, 0 freezes the current frame.
setting.master_switch: Enable FPS Boost; disabling it restores 20 updates per second.
setting.persistence: Existing named global setting save/load path.

implementation: CheatBreaker TextureAnimationTicker schedules the existing texture-manager tick from Minecraft. This covers atlas sprites and the existing registered custom texture-animation callback, without modifying OptiFine source.
rate_changes: Reset fractional progress on rate changes; no frozen-time catch-up or bursts.
scope: Material texture animation ticks only; no entity movement, particle, combat, or game simulation tick changes.

coverage: Slider registration, integer range, default and FPS Boost visibility
All 21 rates across 200 game ticks with multiple texture-manager callbacks
Freeze/resume and rate changes without catch-up
FPS Boost disabled and client startup preserve vanilla ticking
